title: Your Brain on Habits, Explained
desc: Almost half of what you do each day runs on autopilot. Get comfortable and join me for a calm, 2.5-hour journey through habits: William James and the folded paper, life on autopilot, the wandering mind, rats in a maze, a man who learned habits without memory, dopamine and juice, the toothpaste tingle, stale popcorn, soldiers coming home, the doctor who asked for clean hands, the willpower myth, habits under stress, tiny habits, the 66-day truth, exercise, sleep and skill, the 10,000-hour myth, the phone habit, identity, tracking, breaking habits gently, habits of the mind, habits in groups, and why it's never too late. We end with a gentle toolkit and a slow wind-down, so you can fall asleep to the last part if you like.
